judgments.reason: The span 'Revealed epidermal erosion with suprabasal epidermal splitting with acantholysis' appears literally in the histopathology findings and directly supports the histological modifier describing suprabasal epidermal splitting with acantholysis in pemphigus vulgaris.

The span 'Direct immunofluorescence of perilesional skin showed intercellular deposition of IgG and C3 throughout epidermis' appears literally in the clinical record and supports the IgG autoantibody component of the modifier, consistent with pemphigus vulgaris immunopathology.

The span 'Against desmoglein 1: 40 IU/mL (normal value: 20 U/mL)' appears literally in the laboratory findings and supports the positive IgG autoantibodies against desmoglein 1 component of the modifier, as the value is above the normal threshold.

The span 'Against desmoglein 3: 90 IU/mL (normal value: 20 U/mL)' appears literally in the laboratory findings and supports the positive IgG autoantibodies against desmoglein 3 component of the modifier, as the value is well above the normal threshold, characteristic of pemphigus vulgaris.
